target_customer: Compliance officers and product teams at regulated financial firms, fintechs, banks and crypto firms
problem: Mapping regulation to obligations and product requirements takes weeks and delays product launches.
product_category: AI regulatory change management and compliance mapping

founders.name: Areg Nzsdejan
founders.background_notes: YC page: product owner at Revolut leading Diversified Assets and Engagement teams, earlier management consultant.

founders.name: Dmytro Astakhov
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior software engineer at Revolut; the two worked together almost four years.

competitors.name: Norm Ai
competitors.what: Regulatory AI agents for compliance officers
competitors.traction_then: Serving Fortune 100 to small firms per its launch post

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting regulation text, mapping obligations with citations and gap analysis using LLMs is standard engineering with accuracy and audit demands.

defensibility.rationale: Mapped obligations and workflow embedding create some lock-in, but funded rivals Norm Ai and CUBE already operated in the space.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Archer acquired Compliance.ai per search results; no action against Cardamon found.

market_need_then: Regulated fintechs faced heavy regulatory load and the founders report products stuck in compliance review for weeks at Revolut. Early customers named on its site include Nu, Wise, OKX and Binance.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, short punchy lines (Launch. Expand. Stay Compliant.).

brand_strength.rationale: Spelling is a near miss of the spice cardamom, causing confusion in search; some trade press (Microsoft partnership, Trading 212 deployment) but none about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Cardamon is active with 11 people and reported customer wins and partnerships in 2026, including Microsoft's AI partner program (January 2026) and Trading 212 (November 2026). Founders came from Revolut's product team, which matches the pain. No priced round was verified, so funding strength is unknown.
notes: Funding unverified: ZoomInfo lists 500K angel or pre-seed with YC (matches standard YC deal) and Caplight lists a 1.5M seed dated August 2025; neither confirmed by a company or press source, so no round recorded. Search summaries wrongly mixed in other founder backgrounds, so founders come only from the YC page. Customer names are from the company's own site.
